name: mnist-generative-comparison-v1
data: canonical MNIST: 60000 training and 10000 test images; final partial generator batches dropped

sampling.chunk_seed: sampling seed plus first output index

classifier.training: 10000 synthetic images only; same classifier initialization and batch-order seed for each paired generator seed

selection: final fixed-budget generator checkpoint; no test-based model, epoch or seed selection
endpoint: synthetic-only classifier accuracy on the fixed real MNIST test split; per-class recall and confusion matrices
analysis: report all three complete pipeline seed pairs, arithmetic mean, median, sample SD and paired differences; no significance or universal superiority claim from n=3
limits: Locally frozen before new training. Same data, sample count and classifier protocol; generator epochs, batch sizes, optimizer rules, devices and compute budgets differ and are reported. This is not a compute-matched efficiency comparison. Test split and earlier results were known before this follow-up. Inception FID and archived T4 latency are outside this campaign.
